categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in satellite navigation, satellite communication, and electronic countermeasure products. It serves both military and civilian markets, providing terminal products and technical services for defense, aviation, and marine fisheries sectors. The business includes research, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services of specialized electronic equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies in high-performance anti-interference microstrip array antennas, multi-channel frequency conversion, high-dynamic signal capture and tracking, digital adaptive anti-jamming processing, and integrated navigation and communication systems. Production methods include customized non-standard manufacturing for military products and standardized production for civilian products, with a combination of in-house assembly and outsourced component manufacturing. The company also employs advanced design and testing technologies such as FPGA development, phased array antennas, and signal simulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large military groups and their subsidiaries, with products mainly applied in special fields such as national defense and military. Civilian customers include sectors in aviation, marine, and fisheries. The company also targets domestic markets primarily, with limited overseas sales focused on satellite communication products. Major end markets include defense weapon platforms, civil aviation (including C919 aircraft), marine vessels, and electronic warfare systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and production facilities located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Overseas market penetration is limited but includes participation in international exhibitions and some sales in Middle East and Southeast Asia regions. The company is actively exploring international markets, especially in satellite communication.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, manufacturing, and assembly of satellite navigation and communication terminal equipment and electronic countermeasure products. It procures electronic components and modules from suppliers and integrates them into finished products for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in satellite navigation and communication technologies, expanding electronic countermeasure capabilities, and pursuing military-civil integration. The company emphasizes innovation in anti-interference technology, phased array antennas, data link precision timing, and adaptive electronic warfare algorithms. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 53% of revenue allocated to research, and maintains a strong focus on developing indigenous core technologies and expanding product applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of satellite navigation receivers, satellite communication antennas and components, and electronic countermeasure equipment. Sales are recognized upon customer acceptance or delivery, with military products often sold via contract bidding and civilian products through exhibitions and competitive bidding. The company also earns income from government subsidies and technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in satellite navigation and communication terminal equipment, especially in military applications where foreign competition is limited due to export restrictions. In satellite communication, it competes with foreign brands from Japan, Korea, Europe, and the US but has established a comprehensive product line and growing market share domestically. In electronic countermeasures, it is an emerging player with growing technical advantages and market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 139.36 million, a 57.94% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 271.65 million, reflecting a significant increase in losses. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.29 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.63 billion. Despite recent financial challenges due to industry delays and project postponements, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and maintains a stable customer base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong technological innovation and core technology ownership, particularly in anti-interference capabilities, high-precision navigation, and integrated satellite communication systems. Its products are characterized by high reliability, adaptability to harsh electromagnetic environments, and compliance with stringent military standards. The company also highlights its comprehensive product portfolio, strong customer relationships, and ability to provide customized solutions for specialized defense and civilian applications.
